integrity: Analytic proof given for all parameter choices and every positive argument; finite computation is solely reproducibility and consistency checking. No claims of independent external validation, authorship or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Two positive distinct rates, strictly interior weights and common positive real Gamma shape; the same-rate and pure-component cases are specified separately. More than two rates, unequal shapes, other reliability orders and likelihood estimation are not classified. The complete 2022 hyper-Erlang conference paper and 2026 general mixture-separation preprint were not materially available, leaving priority risks.
title: A sharp log-concavity threshold for equal-shape Gamma rate mixtures
